description: 107-活動斷層近地表構造特性調查總報告 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 107年活動斷層近地表構造特性調查總報告，本計劃四年期間之工作針對三義斷層等12條斷層，對其區域近地表構造進行淺層震測等淺地表地球物理研究，輔助判釋地下構造。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
